The black cat puppet is built from dark charcoal cardstock with bright pale yellow paper circle eyes, slender limbs, thin dark brown ink lines drawn inside cut edges, and visible brass split pins at shoulder and hip joints. Physical imperfections include minor paper curling at corners and faint paper grain texture. Palette restricted to mustard yellow, deep teal, olive green, dusty rose, warm oak brown, orange cardstock, and dark charcoal cardstock.
